author: Cleo Abram
description:
If you dug a hole in your nearest forest between the tree roots you would see

A giant web of FUNGI…SO BIG that if you took what’s in just the top layer of the Earth and spread it out…

It would be nearly as long as half the Milky Way Galaxy!

And trees use this network to TALK TO ONE ANOTHER…but what are they saying!?

 If you watch our optimistic videos and you love them, support us, subscribe

title: There's a Secret Network Under Your Feet
